decision.explanation: The question asks who is currently the president of FIFA. Document d2 (D2S1) directly states that 'Since his first election in February 2016, Gianni Infantino's presidency has focused...' which clearly identifies him as the current president. Document d1 (D1S1) mentions Roger Goodell as if he were the president of FIFA, but this appears to be incorrect since Roger Goodell is actually the commissioner of the NFL, not the president of FIFA. Document d3 (D3S2) refers to Daniel Burley Woolfall, who was the first president of FIFA but not the current one. The audit confirms direct support for Gianni Infantino while noting conflicts for the other candidates.
